missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Мозг' is a masculine noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Человеческий' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'сложный' is the predicate adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Мозг' is inanimate masculine, so its accusative equals the nominative as the object of 'изучают'. 'Человеческий' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Мозга' is the genitive showing whose work it is. 'Нашего' agrees in the masculine genitive, and 'работа' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В мозге' uses the prepositional form after 'в' to locate the cells. 'Клеток' is genitive plural after the quantity 'миллиарды'.
Strategic focus: Genitive after для. 'Мозга' is the genitive after 'для' showing benefit. 'Спорт' is the nominative subject, and 'полезен' is the short predicate adjective.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Мозгу' is the dative marking what needs the oxygen. 'Кислород' is the nominative subject, and 'нужен' agrees with it in masculine.
Strategic focus: Accusative object with instrumental. 'Мозг' is the inanimate accusative object of 'загружай'. 'Информацией' is the instrumental of means, and 'лишней' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Мозги' is the inanimate accusative plural, identical to the nominative, as the object of 'тренирует'. The plural here means mental faculties.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Мозги' is the nominative plural and the subject, colloquially meaning brains or wits. 'Хорошие' agrees in the plural, and 'у него' marks the possessor.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Мозгом' is the instrumental showing the tool of thinking. It contrasts with 'сердцем', also instrumental, in this common piece of advice.
